$comment: Generated by scripts/build-spec.mjs from the component sources — do not edit by hand.
name: Toaster
whenToUse: Short feedback on an action just taken: saved, sent, copied, failed.
A background task’s progress (`toast.progress`) or result (`toast.promise`).

whenNotToUse.text: An error people must fix on this page (form, field)

anatomy.description: by type: success, info, warning, error.

do.caption: What happened, to what.
do.example: <Fire label="Show good toast" run={() => toast.success('Certificate issued', { description: 'shop.seashell.dev · valid 90 days' })} />

do.caption: Errors stay until closed and offer a retry.
do.example: <Fire label="Show error toast" run={() => toast.error('Couldn’t reissue certificate', { description: 'DNS check failed for shop.seashell.dev', action: { label: 'Retry', onClick: () => {} } })} />

dont.caption: A field error in a toast: it’s far from the field and the user has to find it.
dont.example: <Fire label="Show field error as toast" run={() => toast.error('Email is invalid')} />

a11y: Toasts are announced politely; errors don’t auto-close, so there is time to read and act.
Never put the only path to something in a toast — it may be gone before people get to it.
Mount `<Toaster />` once at the app root and use `toast` from this module.
